name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
equipment: A quiet space to lie down (or sit comfortably)
instructions: Lie down or sit comfortably, and take several slow breaths to settle in.
Starting with your feet, tense the muscles tightly for 5 seconds, then release and notice the relaxation.
Move up to your calves and thighs, tensing and releasing each in turn.
Continue with your abdomen, hands, and arms, holding tension briefly before letting go.
Tense your shoulders and neck, then your face, before releasing everything at once.
Finish with a few deep breaths, noticing your whole body feeling looser than when you began.
